_about: palOS Latin, Classical register (la). Partial: translated keys only; anything absent falls back to English. Register: Golden-Age prose idiom, no ligatures, u for vowel and v for consonant, I never J. Modern technical vocabulary follows the Neo-Latin computing tradition (computatrum, fasciculus, fenestra, tessera, programma); see glossary.json for every term and its authority. App and product names (palOS, Fen, Seeker, Porpoise, BrushBoard, Quick Look, Disk Utility, Migration Assistant, Startup Disk) are left untranslated, as German and Portuguese palOS builds do. {} and {0}/{1} placeholders are preserved verbatim.
